cohort.0: The study included 87 mother-baby dyads, comprising preterm very low birth weight (VLBW) infants and their mothers from a tertiary level Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.

finding.0: Extremely low birth weight (ELBW) and intrauterine growth-restricted (IUGR) infants were identified as barriers to mothers' own milk (MOM) feeding, while early and frequent milk expression, early night expressions, maternal visits, and early MOM volume were identified as enablers.

followup_time.0: weekly till the discharge of the baby from the unit

birth_weight.0: Mean 1196 (SD 196) grams; includes VLBW and ELBW infants
